suite_name: PRD-CASE paper suite v3 (frozen finite-shot extension)
evidence_role: The v1 exact expansion is pilot/descriptive evidence, the v2 matched A-CASE extension is confirmatory exact evidence, and this v3 extension freezes the finite-shot protocol before any v3 sampled result is generated.

pilot_provenance.selection_rule: For each declared physical family and size, retain the largest preregistered M for which orthogonal residual and SVD-orthonormalized Krylov had matched effective rank on every interaction or geometry member. The rule uses only the producer invariant, never an energy or method ranking.

completed_exact_provenance.basis_selection_evidence: M=7, K=16 was recommended after exact-suite completion because the same fixed packet rule was accuracy-qualified on all three predeclared finite-shot systems. No finite-shot outcome was used.

finite_shot_tier.basis_policy: Load the realized M=7, K=16 packet-Davidson supports, coefficients, and paired Pauli Hamiltonian frozen before sampling, then require their canonical digest. Pairing avoids molecular-orbital gauge drift on rebuild.
finite_shot_tier.seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence([20260811, system_index, shot_budget, seed]); cells are independent rather than nested

estimator.measurement_bank: complete shared S/H Pauli-word universe of identity plus six realized packet directions
estimator.matrix_assembly: one measured upper triangle mirrored by Hermiticity
estimator.sample_reuse: the same grouped outcomes reconstruct every S/H entry

solver.evidence_boundary: Both shot-calibrated overlap rules are data-dependent regularization diagnostics using asymptotic normal radii, not finite-sample coverage certificates.

finite_shot_tier.claim_boundary: This is a finite-shot estimator stress test on bases and allocation coefficients frozen by exact simulation. It does not make packet selection hardware-accessible and does not support a quantum-advantage or physical-runtime claim.

analysis_revision.reason: The exact suite is complete. This revision adds only the previously declared finite-shot tier and freezes every choice that the v1 manifest left underspecified.
analysis_revision.preregistration_rule: Publish the v3 manifest, producer, and tests before executing any v3 sampled task.
analysis_revision.reuse_policy: Exact v1/v2 records select and validate the frozen packet bases. They are not relabelled finite-shot evidence.
